issue: Disconnected from main network; 193 m from city boundary
investigation: Isolated node 8724938731 with no road segments in the graph. In OSM it lies on way 942197324 (highway=residential, maxspeed=20, no access or service restriction; alt name Baguio-Bauang Road), which connects via Catalino Drive (way 765386722, in the main network) to Elpidio Quirino Highway. The way is a public road that should pass the road filter but is missing from the graph. The node is about 200 m from the graph's western edge (min longitude 120.5465), so the most likely cause is truncation at the download boundary. Satellite imagery agrees with OSM.
evidence_source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/8724938731; way 942197324 (version 3, changeset 155132649, last edited over 2 years before the extract); Catalino Drive way 765386722
action: Team decision 2026-11-24: regenerate the road graph with a buffered download boundary to prevent edge truncation. Node expected to reconnect via way 942197324.
notes: Not explained by the service-road filter or outdated data (way unchanged for 2+ years). ROAD-023 and ROAD-024 are also within ~150 m of the graph's western edge; check whether the same truncation affected them.

issue: Unexpected highway tag: ['unclassified', 'residential']
investigation: Edge 4757832782→7908474242 merges two consecutive OSM ways during graph simplification: way 346317438 (Summer Hill Route, highway=unclassified) and way 953087702 (Ongasan Road, highway=residential). Both are real, continuous road sections and the tags are valid in OSM. Satellite imagery agrees with OSM.
action: Not a data error. In preprocessing, assign one road class to merged edges, for example the higher-ranked class (unclassified).
notes: Affects the road-classification feature for the ML model; the preprocessing team should apply one rule to all list-valued attributes (highway, name, osmid). Way 346317438 also carries note:road_class=private (source: Baguio City Engineering Office) but no access tag, so the graph treats it as public; Team decision 2026-11-24: keep Summer Hill Route routable. Way 953087702 has an OSM description noting its name (possibly Demonstration Mines Road) needs verification; no effect on routing.
